business_summary: Zijin Gold International Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, mining, processing, smelting, refining, and sale of gold and other non-ferrous metals. The company's principal products include gold bullion, alloy, doré, bars, and gold concentrate. It operates in Colombia, Suriname, Australia, Tajikistan, Ghana, Guyana, Papua New Guinea, Kyrgyzstan, and Kazakhstan. The company was formerly known as Jinfeng (HK) International Mining Company Limited. Zijin Gold International Company Limited was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong. Zijin Gold International Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Gold Mountains (Hong Kong) International Mining Company Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Zijin Gold International Company Limited는 금 및 기타 비철금속의 탐사, 채굴, 가공, 제련, 정제 및 판매에 종사합니다. 회사의 주요 제품에는 금괴, 합금, 도레, 바, 금 농축물이 포함됩니다. 콜롬비아, 수리남, 호주, 타지키스탄, 가나, 가이아나, 파푸아뉴기니, 키르기스스탄, 카자흐스탄에서 운영됩니다. 이 회사의 이전 이름은 Jinfeng (HK) International Mining Company Limited였습니다. Zijin Gold International Company Limited는 2000년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 구룡에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Zijin Gold International Company Limited는 Gold Mountains (Hong Kong) International Mining Company Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
